name: d3-circuits
note: Build-to-a-number on the S6 base: circuits are short (4 assemblers, ~50/min) while copper furnaces sit full. Needs calc (cable:circuit 3:2), an assembler block, and feeding it from existing plates. Run 1 met the old capacity-only check with hand-filled input chests and an output chest; now delivery (used +100/min) must hold 4 samples.

objectives.name: circuits-150
objectives.goal: @{agent} we're short on green circuits. Build a circuit block that adds at least 120 a minute, fed from our existing iron and copper, and send the output where circuits are needed.

score.name: circuit_capacity_per_min
score.lua: local cap=0 for _,a in pairs(s.find_entities_filtered{type='assembling-machine', force=f}) do local r=a.get_recipe() if r and r.name=='electronic-circuit' and (a.status==defines.entity_status.working or a.status==defines.entity_status.full_output) then cap=cap+60*a.crafting_speed/r.energy end end return cap
score.note: circuits/min the circuit assemblers can make when not starved; +120 over the start

score.name: circuits_used_per_min
score.note: delivered: consumers use 100/min more than at the start (hand-filled chests and an output chest don't count)
